---
title: Vegetable fritters
id: MAR-0043
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 100 g flour
- 2 egg
- 2 zucchini
- 2 carrot
- 2 potato
- to taste frying oil,
- to taste salt and pepper,
## Method
1. Make a batter by mixing the eggs with the flour; season with salt and pepper.
2. Peel the potatoes and wash them with the carrots and zucchini.
3. Grate the vegetables and add them to the batter.
4. Heat plenty of oil and fry the mixture by spoonfuls, a few at a time.
5. Drain the fritters, place them on paper towels, salt them and serve hot.
